steps.title: Open the security settings
steps.text: Open Settings, Privacy, search, and services, then Security.

steps.title: Turn secure DNS on
steps.text: Turn on Use secure DNS and choose a service provider.

steps.title: Give it this address
steps.text: Enter this address as the custom provider and save.

steps.title: Check the setup
steps.text: A few seconds after saving, run this check to see that the device uses this Endpoint.
